implementation.single_gallery_path: Desktop, Android and iPad shells now create scenes through the shared GallerySession fixed-tick path. Gallery workload/profile selection and the legacy/F8 clock switch were removed; the runtime reports fixed-tick-60hz-v1.
implementation.fixed_tick_policy: Interactive callbacks submit at most one 1/60-second, one-substep tick. Excess elapsed work and stalls are discarded instead of caught up; 30 Hz is reported as half-speed, and 90/120/144 Hz renders interpolate between ticks.
implementation.lifecycle: Pause, reset, scene replacement, background and foreground reset elapsed debt. Scripted and qualification stepping use explicit fixed ticks without wall-clock throttling.
implementation.presentation: The iPad shell no longer requests 30 FPS. Its display link prefers 60 Hz where supported, while preserving the display maximum and an explicit 30 Hz lower range.
implementation.scene_migration: All 26 scenes supported by the sole runtime receive fixed-tick-safe material, coupling and pressure parameters. Cloth fracture remains an explicit unavailable capability for cloth-tear and soft-body-cloth, with no fallback.
implementation.artifact_identity: Desktop and mobile runtime state, qualification reports and deployment checks bind the source revision, backend, execution contract and clean/dirty source identity to the candidate artifact.
implementation.runtime_capacity: Rigid and deformable-smoke coupling limits are independently sized for the migrated catalog, and smoke tracer commit work remains fused into the fixed schedule's existing grid dispatch budget.
